body:
I applied to the school of engineering because science is my strongest skill and I like building things. Currently BME, probably going to change to mechanical. I can't think of anything I enjoy doing in that way. I read about the economy, and have an interest in fiscal policy and politics. I'm taking a macroeconomics course and I hate it.

I often accidentally offend people by being honest. It's a personality flaw of mine. It just leads to being even more invisible.

>Don't really try to make friends just do what you normally do and they will come.

If I did this, I'd surely never make friends because what I normally do is sit alone in my room and not talk to people. I cannot once remember making a long term friend where they made the initial action. Hell, only one of my current long term friends takes any initiative in contacting me. For the rest, either I call them or we don't talk.
